name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.leafView_close_encryptor
title: The leaf view over the WE encryptor's own setup: real vs simulated
statement: Under the hypotheses of encryptorSetup_close and leafView_close_succinct: the real leaf view (attribute 0) and the simulated leaf view (attribute w), both with the encryptor's own (W, T) (leafSetupEnc: W with a gadget trapdoor, T by flooding, no trapdoor for B), are within twice the bound of encryptorSetup_close plus twice the leftover-hash bound m sqrt(q^n/2^m)/2.
